crossRefs.note: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
On that night, the king couldn’t sleep. He commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought, and they were…
When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint;’
So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that…
For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore have my words been rash.

translations.web: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
translations.bsb: You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
translations.kjv: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
translations.asv: Thou holdest mine eyes watching: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
